nodes.author: TheVirusAlert
nodes.text: Funny how scientists call human metapneumovirus HMPV virus and not HMP virus. HMPV virus means human metapneumovirus virus. Just like ATM machine & chai tea. Both means automatic teller machine machine and tea tea. So HMP virus is a better option but we still call it HMPV virus.

nodes.author: TheVirusAlert
nodes.text: But for some reason HMPV virus is still acceptable as correct. (Sorry I was bored and just thinking posting this was interesting).

nodes.author: TheVirusAlert
nodes.text: HMP virus is also correct to those wondering. So we can call it whatever. But it's just funny to see that we can't do the same for ATM machine and chai tea even though they have the same stance.
